_about.purpose: Facility registry used ONLY by netra/response.py to compute a SIMULATED responder access route (nearest facility -> incident) on an offline-cached OpenStreetMap drive graph. Nothing in NETRA contacts, notifies or dispatches any facility listed here.
_about.STATUS: MOST ENTRIES BELOW ARE ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER COORDINATES FOR DEMONSTRATION ONLY. They are NOT a verified emergency-services registry. Read the per-entry 'coordinate_source' field before believing any coordinate in this file.

coordinate_source_values.illustrative_placeholder: Invented for the demo. The point lies in the right general area so the routing computation has somewhere realistic to start from, but it does NOT correspond to a surveyed facility at that position. Every such entry also carries '(placeholder)' in its name so it cannot be misread on a map pin. Replace with a real registry before any operational use.
coordinate_source_values.openstreetmap_amenity_tag: Taken from OpenStreetMap's amenity tag. This means someone tagged a building as a hospital/police station/fire station. It is NOT a verified claim of trauma capability, emergency capability, bed availability, staffing or current operating status. Present as 'nearest tagged facility', never as 'verified trauma centre'.

_about.how_to_replace: Swap the 'facilities' array for a real municipal or state registry with the same keys (name, kind, latitude, longitude, city, coordinate_source). netra/response.py reads only those keys and ignores everything else.
_about.why_these_places: NETRA's demo cameras are not all in one city. config/cameras/ currently geolocates CUTTACK_LINK_01 (20.4625, 85.8830) and GANGTOK_6MILE_01 (27.3170, 88.6060); the Electronics City, Bengaluru cluster is retained because the sibling system's corpus sits there. Cameras with no latitude/longitude get an explicit 'no coordinates' degradation from response.py rather than a route.
_about.consumer_contract: Every consumer of this file must carry an explicit simulated=true marker. netra/response.py sets ResponsePlan.access_simulated=True on the data itself before any route is attempted.
